Both numbers are near zero and agree in sign.

findings.finding: The FY8/26 result is likely to land above the 13 July plan (ordinary 4,557m; implied Q4 Jun-Aug ordinary 1,099m / OP 1,160m) because LME copper rose through Q4 (monthly averages June 615.7, July 613.5, August 651.1 c/lb, closing August near 659) and this recycler earns its spread on rising prices with a months-long buy-to-sell lag; the company itself added a 10-yen special dividend on 17 August citing 'the year's solid performance'.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 beat + 75% upward revision on 2026-07-13: +13.3% (baseline estimated date 2026-07-13) and then fully faded to ~1,231 within seven sessions; H1 in line with guide held on 2026-04-13: -11.85% (kabutan/Fisco 'guide held, 出尽くし'). The stock sells past-period beats unless the guide moves.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the 17 August special dividend told holders the year was tracking well, and the stock has since fallen 21%, so the price is not carrying a beat premium. What is not visible is the size: no revision was filed after 13 July (a 30% OP deviation would be needed to force one), and in Oct-2024 this company disclosed a -36% OP deviation only on results day, so silence does not bound the Q4 number. If the beat were priced the stock would be trading near its August high, not 21% below it.
findings.independence: Copper series from Cochilco via Reporte Minero (https://www.reporteminero.cl/noticia/noticias/2026/08/el-precio-del-cobre-promedia-5965-centavos-por-libra-a-julio-y-acumula-un-alza-interanual-del-387 and https://www.reporteminero.cl/noticia/noticias/2026/08/precio-cobre-cochilco-la-rueda-18-agosto-2026-bml-inventarios); company dividend notice https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260817/140120260817521679.pdf. The mechanism (Q4 margin follows the copper direction) is the company's own explanation of its FY8/24 miss: https://www2.jpx.co.jp/disc/31680/140120241010596550.pdf

findings.finding: The first FY8/27 guide is likely to show a large profit decline: MERF guided FY8/26 at ordinary 407m (OP 744m, H1 sales -9%) in Oct-2025 and will finish near 4.5bn+, and its Nov-2025 mid-term plan revised the FY8/27 final-year target to sales 90bn, ordinary margin 2.4% (~2.2bn) and NP 1.5bn with a 30% payout -- so a guide anchored near that target implies roughly EPS ~105 and a dividend near 30 yen against FY8/26's 40 yen (20 ordinary + 10 commemorative + 10 special); partly offset by copper starting FY8/27 at record levels (~6.5-6.58 USD/lb in early October) which could lift the guide above the plan.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guide events on this name are the large movers: FY8/25 first guide (Oct-2024, est.) -5.29%; FY8/26 first guide (Oct-2025, est.) +0.92%; guide raised Jan/Feb-2026 +19.3% and heavy buying; guide held Apr-2026 -11.85%; guide raised Jul-2026 +13.3%.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced by valuation: at 1,206 the stock trades at 6.1x the FY8/26 EPS plan, which only makes sense if the market already expects earnings to fall, and it has dropped 21% since mid-August while copper stayed at records. What is not priced is the headline mechanics: a kabutan '今期経常は○割減益' line plus a dividend guide below the 40 yen that sets today's displayed 3.3% yield, read by a register with margin longs at 3.18x. If this were fully held, the stock would not still show a 3.3% headline yield on a one-off dividend. Capped small because the FY8/27 bar is unsourced.
findings.independence: Initial FY8/26 guide in the FY8/25 English results (https://kabutan.jp/disclosures/pdf/20251010/140120251010571836/), the 13 July revision text warning of copper volatility in Q4 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260713/140120260618574058.pdf) and the dividend composition (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260817/140120260817521679.pdf) are separate documents from the same company. The offsetting copper level is from https://www.redimin.cl/cobre-sube-a-us-6-579-la-libra-en-londres-mientras-inventarios-caen-0-8 (secondary, snippet_only).
